response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_order_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), gender_shares AS (SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count, 1.0 * invoiced_order_count / SUM(invoiced_order_count) OVER () AS share FROM gender_counts), compared AS (SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM gender_shares) SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
